title: Find Response
description: Output of the FindAction invocable action (payload inside the MCP envelope).

noticeConfidential.title: Notice: Confidential
noticeConfidential.description: Data-handling notice: the data may contain confidential information.

noticeShareCheck.title: Notice: Share Check
noticeShareCheck.description: Data-handling notice: check the recipients and the content before sharing.

noticeResponsibility.title: Notice: Responsibility
noticeResponsibility.description: Data-handling notice: the user is responsible for handling the data.

succeeded.title: Succeeded
succeeded.description: True when the query ran. False when the input was rejected or the query failed.

errorMessage.title: Error Message
errorMessage.description: Why the call failed. Empty when it succeeded.

recordCount.title: Record Count
recordCount.description: Number of records returned. For SELECT COUNT() queries, the number of matching records.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: True when more records matched than the limit of 200 and the result was cut off.

resultJson.title: Result JSON
resultJson.description: The result as a JSON string.
